test_hdf5_logger_write_read: test that messages written to an HDF5 file can be read back and verified
test_hdf5_logger_field_types: test the HDF5 logger handles StrType, StrDynamicType, and DynamicType field types correctly
test_hdf5_logger_serializable_dynamic: test the HDF5 logger preprocesses and postprocesses SERIALIZABLE_DYNAMIC_TYPES like ListType and DataclassType
test_hdf5_logger_string_encoding: test that string fields are decoded using the correct encoding from StrType or StrDynamicType
test_hdf5_logger_dynamic_bytes: test that DynamicType fields excluding StrDynamicType are compared as raw bytes
